chapter: Don Redman's band at Connie's Inn
title: Why he left Redman: the Cleveland New Year's job and joining Calloway
summary: Redman's band declined; after an unpaid New Year's Eve job in Cleveland he came back to New York, leading to Calloway's band in January 1940.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: How long -- Now, what did you -- After you stayed at Connie's, with Don Redman at Connie's Inn, what was your next band?
Oh, yes. Well, that was about 19 -- was it -- ?
That's right. I joined the band in
Uh-huh. Well, I was in the band then?

You know, how that happened was Don's band was kind of going downgrade then and so we went -- it's a funny thing. We went to Cleveland to play a New Year's Eve dance. When we got to Cleveland the guy didn't have no money and we rode a bus in all that snow -- and there was a lot of snow -- to get to Cleveland, in all that snow.
